profile.name: ACQ400 数据流客户端
profile.description: 用于连接 ACQ400/ACQ2106 系列采集系统的主机端软件客户端，负责实时数据流读取、状态监视、通道数据获取、校准换算以及采集相关服务配置。它用于实验中的高速数据采集与后处理，本身不是实体仪器。
profile.description_en: A host-side software client for connecting to ACQ400/ACQ2106 acquisition systems. It handles live data streaming, status monitoring, channel data retrieval, calibration-based scaling, and acquisition-related service configuration. It is used for high-speed experimental data capture and post-processing, and is not a physical instrument itself.

registry.name: Stream
registry.description: Stream Client是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括使能、停止、关闭、初始化、加载、参数配置。支持SVC, Signal, Slot等操作。
